claims.text: SAP sets end of mainstream maintenance and an optional extended-maintenance window (with premium) for Business Suite 7
Choice of conversion (greenfield/brownfield/selective) determines which historical data remains in ECC or moves
Cleared and open AR/AP items live in different ECC tables; clearing links are required to show which payment matched which invoice
ECC stores posted amounts in document currency and company-code local currency (and often parallel currencies) which must be preserved
Custom (Z) reports hold logic auditors rely on and should be extracted with the data

evidence.quote: Mainstream maintenance for the core applications of SAP Business Suite 7 ends at the close of 2027, and optional extended maintenance runs to the end of 2030 at a premium of two percentage points on the maintenance basis.
A greenfield implementation starts the new system with balances, open items, and active master data, and the closed years stay behind in ECC.
Open receivables and payables sit in BSID and BSIK, and once an item is cleared it moves to BSAD or BSAK.
Every ECC posting stores its amounts in the document currency and in the company code’s local currency, and many groups carry further parallel currencies.
In the same retirement, three customer-specific reports covering the journal, vendors, and customers were extracted alongside the standard tables.
